decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits close to the core seasonal assortment, so keeping it costs little, and it remains a cheap option even though its visibility since 2019 is unclear.
The one-tier pyramid uses established production skills and fits the traditional range, so its low holding cost justifies keeping it while demand settles after the pandemic years.
The electronic music box line is distant from the core and its companion platforms were already dropped, but as the flagship growth option with several models it merits more time before abandonment.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core craftsmanship and has steady gift and tourist appeal, so keeping it remains inexpensive and sensible.
